CANDIDATE e1e5ab4f5b3826593dd2087e37d84e4f8c04b842 on scout/transition-position, base 220cbdcc23274ffd42206e53b56fcd042925ee17 (current main). Mote record cand-3N47S9ZY2QPVY2N7FXZZCHTWFT; bead bd-01M17Y03XGDD0XR26PN41TJVRJ. Two reserved paths only.

WHAT CHANGED. TransitionFeatures now asks measuredPosition for both endpoints. If either is absent, Backward and LongJump are absent from the already-sparse feature map: no directional evidence is invented. If both are measured, the keys remain present; a real measured zero is distinguishable from absence. No new vocabulary, dependency, or module.

MUTATION RUN. Restoring the old relativePosition fallback makes the new court fail at the first Backward-absence assertion; it reports 0/1. Restoring the fix gives focused 1/1.

SCOPED GATE on final formatted bytes: align JVM 213/213, JS 213/213, Native 213/213; Compile/Test scalafmtCheck green. Root main is tracked-clean and unmoved; the candidate was created directly on its branch.

FULL GATE DISCLOSURE. In an exact clean local clone, compileAll completed green. testAll then passed core 127/127 on JVM, JS, and Native plus proposition JVM 51/51. I intentionally interrupted during proposition JS when free disk fell from 8.9 GiB to 7.7 GiB; this repository previously failed at 7.1 GiB. I removed the temporary clone, but only 8.0 GiB is currently free. Therefore testAll is explicitly PENDING and this is not landing-ready despite the complete portable align gate.

Candidate ledger reports ancestor_pending twice plus missing review/authorization. Git ancestry is unambiguous: the sole parent is current main 220cbdc; per AGENTS rule 3 the ledger phase is advisory. Requesting read-only exact-SHA review now; chief authorization and a completed clean testAll remain required.
